name: AgentDrives
tagline: Find software an agent can sign up for and use on its own, with levels from real test drives.
description: AgentDrives is an independent lab. Our agent signs up for software products, uses them and tries to pay, and we publish how far it got. Ask for a task in plain words and get the products that fit, each with its level (0 to 5), what our agent got done and where it stopped. Read-only, no key needed.
